name: AI Agent Library Registry Index
purpose: Curated index of registries that can be used to populate the AI Agent Library site with build-ready content, source assets, tools, deployments, assistants, and operating stacks.

registries.name: Assistant Stacks
registries.description: Bundled assistant systems that combine GPT brains, tool widgets, host sites, AI Studio apps, and API actions by vertical.
registries.siteUse: Create stack cards, build recipes, vertical pages, and deployment packets.
registries.buildPrompt: Turn this assistant stack into a deployment recipe with brain, widgets, host site, API action, missing pieces, file plan, and acceptance criteria.

registries.name: Custom GPTs
registries.description: Catalog of built and published Custom GPTs with descriptions, access URLs, funnel fit, audience, category, and output type.
registries.siteUse: Populate assistant directory, agent workbench options, and stack dependencies.
registries.buildPrompt: Convert this GPT record into an agent profile page with use cases, inputs, outputs, prompts, related tools, and launch CTAs.

registries.name: Funding Tools
registries.description: Large catalog of funding calculators, funnels, dashboards, and lead magnets with persona, problem, logic, output artifact, and build state.
registries.siteUse: Populate tool build queue, engineering-as-marketing library, and tool generation prompts.
registries.buildPrompt: Turn this tool record into a static HTML/CSS/JS calculator or funnel with inputs, logic, outputs, CTA, disclaimer, and tracking events.

registries.name: Engineering-as-Marketing Tools
registries.description: Registry schema for engineering-as-marketing tools and financial calculators including deployment mode, channel, live URL, production status, inputs, outputs, embed, SEO, analytics, and compliance.
registries.siteUse: Use as the schema standard for every tool card and build packet.
registries.buildPrompt: Normalize this tool concept into a complete EAM tool spec with logic, inputs, outputs, embed settings, SEO, analytics, dependencies, and compliance.

registries.name: Vercel Deployments
registries.description: Inventory of live Vercel deployments with live URLs, repos, last deploy timing, status, and duplicate flags.
registries.siteUse: Populate live portfolio, deployment status pages, and broken-link QA queue.
registries.buildPrompt: Create a deployment inventory card with live link, repo, status, last deploy, related assistant stack, and QA next step.

registries.name: GitHub Repos
registries.description: Repository inventory with name, slug, visibility, description, GitHub URL, and duplicate flags.
registries.siteUse: Map site assets to repositories, identify orphaned deployments, and generate implementation issues.
registries.buildPrompt: Turn this repo record into a repo profile with purpose, live site match, missing docs, action files, and next PR tasks.

registries.name: AI Studio Apps
registries.description: Inventory of Google AI Studio apps with URLs, descriptions, modified dates, and duplicate flags.
registries.siteUse: Populate Gemini app directory and cross-link AI Studio apps with agent profiles and build packets.
registries.buildPrompt: Convert this AI Studio app into a Gemini app profile with purpose, target user, inputs, outputs, related repo, and deployment notes.

registries.name: Borrower Qualification Stack
registries.description: Build-ready stack for turning cold traffic into pre-qualified, routed funding applicants using GPT brains, pre-qual widgets, host sites, API actions, and a shared scoring contract.
registries.siteUse: Create the first flagship build recipe and implementation blueprint.
registries.buildPrompt: Turn this stack into a complete implementation plan with scoring module, widget wiring, GPT Action schema, CRM routing, QA steps, and launch checklist.

registries.name: Funding Pages
registries.description: Page registry driving a funding hub and lane pages with SEO, hero, sections, data references, filters, and compliance rules.
registries.siteUse: Use as the page schema model for dynamic library pages and funding lane content.
registries.buildPrompt: Generate a public-safe funding page from this registry record with hero, sections, tool grid, disclaimers, CTAs, and SEO metadata.

registries.name: Funding Providers
registries.description: Funding partner/provider data with products, eligibility, terms, routing, affiliate configuration, source links, and verification status.
registries.siteUse: Power lender/provider matching, internal routing rules, and provider directory cards.
registries.buildPrompt: Create a provider card with eligibility, products, best-fit borrower, routing notes, affiliate status, and public-safe disclaimer.

registries.name: Credit Vendors
registries.description: Business credit vendor/tradeline list with tier, category, bureaus reported, terms, PG requirements, EIN-only status, and approval notes.
registries.siteUse: Populate business-credit roadmap, vendor comparison pages, and readiness widgets.
registries.buildPrompt: Turn this vendor record into a public-safe vendor card with reporting bureaus, tier, terms, setup notes, and no-guarantee disclaimer.

registries.name: Flash UI Prompts
registries.description: Reusable Flash UI generation prompts for calculators, directories, quizzes, funnels, toolkits, dashboards, portals, and landing pages.
registries.siteUse: Populate prompt library, design generator, and site build packet output.
registries.buildPrompt: Package this prompt into a reusable build recipe with audience, CTA, layout, files, interactions, and QA checklist.

registries.name: AI Automation System Templates
registries.description: Static site and template specs for AI Automation Systems Library, agent profile templates, and automation profile templates.
registries.siteUse: Upgrade the AI Agent Library from flat catalogs into profile pages and blueprint templates.
registries.buildPrompt: Use this template record to generate a complete static page layout, data model, interaction logic, and content schema.
